summary: The Kohanim went up the steps of the Ulam. The ones who had cleaned the inner mizbe'ach and the Menorah went first to take their vessels out. One lamp was left burning to light the Menorah in the afternoon.
stIntro: The priest with the panful of incense and the priest with the gold coal pan filled with coals

chunks.st: began ascending the twelve stairs of the Entrance Hall.

summary: The Kohen who won the ketores got help from a friend. They warned him to start far away so he would not get burned. Everyone left, and when the memuneh said "Burn!", he burned the ketores.

chunks.en: The one who won the ketores

chunks.st: Burn the incense. And if it was the High Priest who was burning the incense,

chunks.en: the memuneh says,

chunks.en: "My master, Kohen Gadol,
chunks.st: My master, the High Priest,

chunks.en: burn it!" The people moved away,
chunks.explain: No one may stand near while the ketores is burned.
chunks.st: burn the incense. It is derived from the verse: “And there shall be no man in the Tent of Meeting when he goes in to make atonement in the Sanctuary, until he comes out” (Leviticus 16:17), that no one may be standing between the Entrance Hall and the outer altar when the priest burns the incense. Therefore, the people, i.e., the priests, left that area.

chunks.en: and he burned it, bowed down, and went out.
chunks.st: And the priest burned the incense on the inner altar and prostrated himself and emerged from the Sanctuary.
